text: Create an authored animation-quality benchmark for Grade 5 place value. Teach how to identify the value of a digit using twenty three as one continuous worked example: group and trade ones into tens, connect two tens and three ones to notation, then deliberately multiply twenty three by ten to make two hundred and thirty. Explain that regrouping keeps the quantity unchanged, while multiplication by ten changes it. Show the zero in the ones place of two hundred and thirty and the value of its three. Ask the learner for the value of four in three hundred and forty, explain forty, and recap. Use concrete base-ten demonstrations with an illustrated guide.
